_comment: 'If this was played from arsenal, it gains +1{p}.' Pump shape per DSL_REFERENCE: TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK + MODIFY_ATTACK (an Action - Attack card is not an ATTACK_REACTION). PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL reads card.played_from_zone - stamped by play.py at the moment of play - falling back to prev_zone from Zone.add; the handler's own note says the two agree on the arsenal -> combat chain move, so the gate is true exactly when this copy was played from arsenal. Ability-level conditions are checked at resolution (interpreter._run_ability), which is after the stamp exists. A hand play leaves the gate false, matching the release note ('You may still play Burgeoning from your hand. It would not gain the +1{p}.'). No printed keywords, so no conditional-keyword machinery is involved.
